  UNION SELECT DISTINCT XCL_081 FROM Match WHERE XCL_009 = '2015/2016' AND XCL_081 IS NOT NULL
  UNION SELECT DISTINCT XCL_082 FROM Match WHERE XCL_009 = '2015/2016' AND XCL_082 IS NOT NULL
),
base AS (
  SELECT p.XCL_122 AS pid
  FROM Player p
  JOIN played pl ON p.XCL_122 = pl.pid
  WHERE p.XCL_126 > 180
),
rated AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pa.XCL_130 AS pid
  FROM Player_Attributes pa
  WHERE pa.XCL_132 > 70
    AND SUBSTR(pa.XCL_131,1,4) BETWEEN '2013' AND '2015'
)
SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.pid IS NOT NULL THEN b.pid END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT b.pid) AS percentage
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN rated r ON b.pid = r.pid;
